records.text: Owens questioned why public-relations professional Johnnie Moore was selected to lead the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation and said the selection seemed remarkably corrupt.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I have no idea why he got this position. It seems remarkably corrupt. ... He was just running PR.

verification.notes: Moore’s appointment as executive chair is confirmed. The assertion that he had no apparent qualification is evaluative and incomplete: sources document PR work but also humanitarian advocacy and relief-related board experience, while critics disputed whether he had direct aid-delivery experience.

sources.title: Guardian: GHF names Johnnie Moore chair
sources.relevance: Confirms appointment and records GHF’s claim of humanitarian experience.

sources.relevance: Documents prior humanitarian and religious-freedom work.

records.text: Financial Times reporting, as summarized by an unnamed website read by Candace Owens, said Project Aurora began in late 2024 as a pro bono feasibility study for the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation and developed over seven months into consulting contracts reportedly worth $4 million.
records.speaker: Financial Times

appearances.snippet: This website tells us—and I'm going to read this website directly—it says, launched in late 2024, Project Aurora was originally framed as a pro bono feasibility study for the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, a Geneva-registered NGO created with backing from U.S. and Israeli security-linked interests. Over seven months, the project evolved into fully billed ... consulting contracts reportedly worth $4 million. According to a series of leaked documents obtained by the Financial Times, the core of the work focused on estimating the financial costs of various scenarios for Gaza’s post-conflict future.

verification.notes: Financial Times reporting describes seven months of Project Aurora work, beginning as a pro bono feasibility study in October 2024 and developing into contracts worth more than $4 million. BCG’s parliamentary response confirms the pro bono start and later for-fee engagement, while stating that BCG ultimately collected no fees.

sources.title: BCG modelled plan to relocate Palestinians from Gaza
sources.relevance: Financial Times reporting confirms the October 2024 pro bono start, seven-month development, and contracts worth more than $4 million.

sources.title: Boston Consulting Group response to the Business and Trade Committee
sources.relevance: BCG’s formal account confirms the pro bono phase and later for-fee engagement, while clarifying that fees were not collected.

records.text: Boston Consulting Group helped develop the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation's logistics and organizational structure and set pricing for private security contractors operating its Gaza food-distribution hubs.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Was also, as we just told you, instrumental in setting up that Gaza Humanitarian Foundation. That's ringing a bell for you. ... The consulting firm helped to develop the logistics, the organizational structure, and they also set the pricing for paying and equipping private security contractors to operate the food distribution hubs in Gaza.

verification.notes: BCG’s formal response confirms organizational, operational, and logistics advice for the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation. Washington Post reporting says BCG designed and ran business operations and set prices for paying and equipping private security contractors at four distribution hubs.

sources.title: Boston Consulting Group helped launch Gaza aid system
sources.relevance: Reports that BCG designed and ran business operations and set contractor prices at four hubs.

sources.title: Boston Consulting Group response to the Business and Trade Committee
sources.relevance: BCG confirms its operational, organizational, and logistics advice.

records.text: The Gaza Humanitarian Foundation's distribution hubs became killing fields where starving Palestinians were led to slaughter as the Israel Defense Forces fired on them.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Okay, that's what that was all about. And this was, of course, backed and funded by Israel, but you might recall that it was then discovered these were effectively just killing fields. ... The videos are horrific. They are available online and you should watch them. You should understand what the IDF army does: starving Palestinians effectively being led to the slaughter as the IDF fires upon them. That was the scandal.

verification.notes: UN and independent reporting confirm repeated killings of Palestinians seeking aid near GHF distribution sites, including incidents involving Israeli military fire. The stronger wording that the hubs were designed as killing fields or deliberately led people to slaughter is not conclusively established and was disputed by the IDF.

sources.title: Gaza: Israeli military kills Palestinians seeking food aid
sources.relevance: UN reporting confirms deaths involving Israeli fire near militarized aid distribution points.

sources.title: How Gaza aid sites became deadly
sources.relevance: Independent reporting documents repeated shootings of aid seekers while also presenting IDF denials and explanations.

records.text: The Times of Israel reported that Johnnie Moore was appointed executive chairman of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation after CEO Jake Wood quit and Boston Consulting Group abandoned the project.
records.speaker: The Times of Israel

appearances.snippet: Check out this headline, Times of Israel. Gaza Humanitarian Foundation taps U.S. evangelical leader Johnny Moore as the new chairman. ... It tells us that he was appointed as the new executive chairman of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, which is the U.S. and Israel-backed organization providing aid to Gazans. ... Its previous CEO, Jake Wood, quit last week and the Boston Consulting Group abandoned the project today.

verification.notes: The Times of Israel reported that GHF appointed Johnnie Moore executive chairman after Jake Wood resigned, and described the change as following Boston Consulting Group’s withdrawal from the project.

sources.title: Gaza Humanitarian Foundation taps Johnnie Moore as new chairman
sources.relevance: Directly confirms Moore’s appointment after Wood’s resignation and BCG’s withdrawal.

records.text: Owens said the unidentified organizer had publicly admitted gathering intelligence and collaborating with Green Berets, Daily Wire employee Kassy Akiva, and the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation under Johnnie Moore to create files on people for Israeli public-relations work
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In the past, before Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was assassinated, that this person hosted a spaces on X and went on record admitting that they gather intel, they collaborate with the Green Berets, they collaborate with a Daily Wire employee, Cassie Akiva, the Gaza Humanitarian Fund then run by Johnny Moore to create files on people for the purpose of doing Israel's PR bidding.

verification.notes: This is Owens's characterization of an alleged earlier X Spaces admission. Research did not authenticate the original recording or the claimed collaborations and tasking. Her retelling alone does not establish the admission's accuracy or the organizer's government role.
